{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats commit to eliminating carbon pollution from power plants by 2035 through technology-neutral standards for clean energy and energy efficiency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will dramatically expand solar and wind energy deployment through community-based and utility-scale systems, including in rural areas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Within five years, Democrats will install 500 million solar panels, including eight million solar roofs and community solar energy systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Within five years, Democrats will install 60,000 wind turbines.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will leverage federal policy to manufacture renewable energy solutions in America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats’ technology-neutral approach to decarbonizing the power sector is inclusive of all zero-carbon technologies, including hydroelectric power, geothermal, existing and advanced nuclear, and carbon capture and storage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States—and the world—must achieve net-zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, and no later than 2050.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
